depth_um.Description: Estimated depth of the electrode contact along the shank, in micrometers, derived from the Blackrock-channel-to-shank-position mapping in the NeuroNexus V1x32-Edge -> Blackrock PN10532 adapter pinout (shank position 1 = tip = 0 um, 100 um increments per position). "n/a" indicates the channel was not found in the pinout map.
